explication: FluidNC is configurable CNC-controller firmware, principally aimed at ESP32, with platform variants and a POSIX simulator. A machine configuration describes axes, kinematics, motors, pins, and tool hardware; the firmware parses it, accepts Grbl-compatible commands, plans motion, and drives step outputs and machine peripherals. Users interact through serial or the built-in Web UI, and jobs can also come from files. The README documents flexible machine types, multiple tools, and AI config helpers. The tree supports these major areas; sampled source chiefly confirms configuration parsing and the stepping-engine interface/implementations.
